name: Fuhou Hinnyuu
source:
By the side of recently renovated Hanamura family mansion there is another lonely building. Carefree girls who live there don't take any precaution measures against spying which is treated by architect main character as an invitation to another sex adventure.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在刚刚翻修一新的花邑家宅邸旁，还伫立着另一栋孤零零的建筑。住在那里的女孩们毫无防备之心，对偷窥丝毫不设防——而在身为建筑师的男主角眼中，这无异于邀请他踏上另一场猎艳冒险的信号。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
